card.name: Day numbers in chemotherapy schedules
card.fires_on: The word day (or the number after it) in cycle schedules such as 'on Day 1', mostly after a mg/m2 dose in chemotherapy regimens. Also fires once inside the word 'counter-regulatory'.

modes.label: Day in dosing schedule

modes.label: Inside regulatory
modes.description: A stray hit partway through the word 'counter-regulatory' in a hormone sentence.
